import datetime

# Recompute electricity-related VENMO transactions this year so far (sent by you)
venmo_password = [a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_username = 'joseharr@gmail.com'
access_token = apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_username, password=venmo_password)['access_token']

now = datetime.datetime.now()
year = now.year
min_created_at = f'{year}-01-01'
max_created_at = f'{year}-{now.month:02d}-{now.day:02d}'

def fetch_all_sent():
    page_limit = 20
    all_sent = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=access_token,
            min_created_at=min_created_at,
            max_created_at=max_created_at,
            direction='sent',
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        if not page:
            break
        all_sent.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
    return all_sent

all_sent = fetch_all_sent()

keywords = ['electricity', 'electric']

electric_tx = []
for t in all_sent:
    desc = (t.get('description') or '').lower()
    if any(k in desc for k in keywords):
        electric_tx.append(t)

amount_sum = sum(t['amount'] for t in electric_tx)
amount_sum = round(amount_sum + 1e-9, 2)

print('Task asks:', 'How much have I paid in electricity bill on venmo this year so far?')
print('Maps to:', 'sent_amount_matching_electricity_descriptions')
print('Value:', amount_sum)
print('Matched_tx_count:', len(electric_tx))
print('Matched_descriptions:', sorted(set(t.get('description') for t in electric_tx)))
